title: 流式治理：高损失领域中绕过内容判断的AI输出管控
summary: 本文提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式，通过基于形式化可数特征的认知成本评分和机构容量上限，在不评估内容的情况下控制AI输出速度，解决高损失领域中人类监督的V×L瓶颈。设计四个不变量，并通过蒙特卡洛分析验证多指标流控制优于单纯监督强化。
summary_en: This paper proposes Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls AI output velocity without content evaluation, using formal feature-based cognitive cost scores and institutional capacity caps to address the V×L bottleneck in high-loss domains. Four design invariants are derived, and Monte Carlo analysis shows multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement in 90.8% of trials.
